parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: get_alert_context
function.description: Retrieve seed account, network accounts, and initial transactions for an alert ID.

function.name: get_account_transactions
function.description: Fetch parameterized read-only transaction history for a specific account within `days_back`.

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: get_alert_context
function.description: Retrieve seed account, network accounts, and initial transactions for an alert ID.

function.name: get_account_transactions
function.description: Fetch parameterized read-only transaction history for a specific account within `days_back`.

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

Hand-off HO-REG (ALT-V2-D0006) — regulatory summary and recommended actions

Summary of applicable rules (high-level)
- The observed amount INR 12,249,414.99 exceeds India’s statutory cash-transaction reporting threshold (INR 1,000,000) and far exceeds cross-border wire reporting threshold (INR 500,000). Periodic threshold filings and prompt STR obligations therefore apply. See PMLR Rule 8(1) and PMLR Rule 3(1)(E). (Cite: PMLR-2005-R8-P01; PMLR-2005-R3-P04)
- Section 12 of the PMLA requires reporting entities to furnish prescribed transaction information (including attempted transactions) to FIU-IND in the manner and time prescribed. (Cite: PMLA-2002-S12-P02)
- FIU-IND / FATF guidance: suspicious transactions must be reported regardless of amount where reasonable grounds of suspicion exist; structuring/smurfing and split transfers designed to evade thresholds are red flags requiring aggregation and STR consideration. (Cite: FATF-R20-P02; FIU-IND-RFI-BA-03; FATF-R16-P05)
- RBI KYC direction: maintain anti-tipping-off confidentiality, follow KYC obligations and sanctions/PEP screening requirements when handling suspicious filings and customer contact. (Cite: RBI-KYC-2016-P70-P01)
- Record retention and FIU information-call compliance obligations require reconstructable records and timely responses. (Cite: PMLA-2002-S12A-P02)

Key regulatory clause IDs to include in the report
- PMLR-2005-R8-P01 — Rule 8(1), PML Rules 2005 (monthly periodic CTR / CBWTR filings by 15th of succeeding month; STR: promptly and not later than seven working days after Principal Officer is satisfied)
- PMLR-2005-R3-P04 — Rule 3(1)(E), PML Rules 2005 (cross-border wire transfers > INR 5,00,000: recordkeeping / CBWTR)
- PMLA-2002-S12-P02 — Section 12(1)(b), PMLA 2002 (statutory duty to furnish prescribed transaction information to FIU-IND; includes attempted/aborted transactions)
- PMLA-2002-S12A-P02 — Section 12A(2)-(3), PMLA 2002 (FIU information calls; confidentiality; record retention)
- FATF-R20-P02 — FATF Recommendation 20 (report suspicious transactions regardless of amount)
- FATF-R16-P05 / FATF-R16-P04 — FATF Recommendation 16 (split wires / missing originator info / screening)
- FIU-IND-RFI-BA-03 — FIU-IND Banking Red Flag: structuring/smurfing below INR 10 lakh threshold
- FIU-IND-RFI-BA-20 — FIU-IND Banking Red Flag: customer evasiveness / missing invoices / KYC gaps
- RBI-KYC-2016-P70-P01 — RBI Master Direction KYC (Para 70: anti-tipping-off / confidentiality)

Immediate recommended actions (operational, statutory-focused)
1) Treat the flow as requiring STR assessment now
   - Because the total observed flow (INR 12,249,414.99) exceeds statutory thresholds and/or meets red-flag patterns, escalate to the Principal Officer for STR determination without delay. (Cite: PMLR-2005-R8-P01; FATF-R20-P02)

2) Prepare filings and preserve timelines
   - If STR is filed: submit Suspicious Transaction Report to FIU-IND promptly and in any event within seven working days from when the Principal Officer is satisfied there are reasonable grounds of suspicion. (Cite: PMLR-2005-R8-P01; PMLA-2002-S12-P02)
   - Ensure periodic filings (CTR / CBWTR / other threshold reports) are prepared for the relevant reporting month and filed by the 15th of the succeeding month if applicable. Because cross-border legs (if any) exceed INR 5,00,000, ensure CBWTR/records are included. (Cite: PMLR-2005-R8-P01; PMLR-2005-R3-P04)

3) Aggregate and analyze linked activity (structuring risk)
   - Aggregate amounts across the subject’s related accounts and network nodes (ACC-D0006-RT00 plus ACC-D0006-IN01–IN07 and ACC-D0006-DS01 and path nodes) across the rolling period to detect structuring/smurfing and split transfers. If multiple legs combine to exceed thresholds, that strengthens reporting obligations. (Cite: FIU-IND-RFI-BA-03; FATF-R16-P05)

4) Sanctions and PEP screening
   - Perform immediate sanctions and PEP screening on originator(s), beneficiary(ies), and related beneficial owners (across all network accounts and path nodes). If any sanctions or PEP hits arise, include findings in the STR and follow escalation protocols. Maintain full audit trail of screening results. (Cite: FATF-R16-P04; RBI-KYC-2016-P70-P01)

5) KYC / documentary evidence collection (without tipping-off)
   - Attempt to obtain/verifiy invoices, GST/commercial documents, beneficial ownership and enhanced KYC as necessary to test benign hypotheses (legitimate commercial trade, loan repayment, intra-group transfer). Frame requests neutrally as routine KYC/account review to avoid tipping-off. Document all customer responses and evasions. (Cite: FIU-IND-RFI-BA-20; RBI-KYC-2016-P70-P01)

6) Preserve records and respond to FIU calls

Hand-off HO-REG — regulatory search summary and actionable guidance (citations only to returned passage IDs)

Key regulatory passages located (exact IDs)
- FIU-IND red-flag on structuring / smurfing below INR 10 lakh threshold: FIU-IND-RFI-BA-03
- PMLA (intent-to-report / reasonable-grounds reporting; do NOT assert guilt): PMLA-2002-S3-P06
- PMLA statutory reporting duty (Section 12(1)(b)): PMLA-2002-S12-P02
- PMLR Rule 8(1) — filing schedules & STR timeline: PMLR-2005-R8-P01
- PMLR Rule 7(3) — align monitoring windows to FIU/RBI guidance; expand windows/hop depth: PMLR-2005-R7-P04
- PMLA confidentiality requirement (no tipping-off): PMLA-2002-S12-P04
- RBI KYC guidance on STRs, no account restrictions solely due to STR filing; use risk-based monitoring: RBI-KYC-2016-P70-P02
- FATF guidance (aggregate split transfers, multi-leg wire monitoring): FATF-R16-P05 and FATF-R16-P04
- PMLA Section 12A record / information obligations and retention: PMLA-2002-S12A-P02

Concise regulatory guidance points to inform escalation decisions (operationalized)
1. Treat low-value legs in scatter-gather schemes as potentially reportable when linked and intended to evade reporting thresholds
   - FIU-IND-RFI-BA-03 requires aggregation of fragmented cash/electronic legs across coordinated accounts and rolling monthly windows; deliberate fragmentation is a red flag even if individual legs are below threshold.

2. Aggregate across time and related accounts before deciding
   - Follow PMLR-2005-R7-P04 and FIU-IND-RFI-BA-03: expand monitoring windows and hop-depth; compute exact sums across linked accounts/legs (rolling monthly windows) to detect threshold evasion and patterning.

3. STR filing obligation and timing
   - Principal Officer must furnish STRs promptly and not later than seven working days after being satisfied that reasonable grounds of suspicion exist (PMLR-2005-R8-P01).
   - Routine threshold reports (e.g., CTR and CBWTR) follow monthly schedules (by 15th of succeeding month) as specified in PMLR-2005-R8-P01.

4. Do not require proof of a predicate offence to report; report on reasonable grounds
   - PMLA-2002-S3-P06 makes clear investigators should report reasonable grounds of suspicion without proving criminal guilt; present neutral, evidence-backed findings.

5. Maintain confidentiality; avoid tipping-off or account restrictions solely because an STR is filed
   - PMLA-2002-S12-P04 mandates strict confidentiality. RBI-KYC-2016-P70-P02 cautions against imposing arbitrary account freezes only because an STR was filed; prefer risk-based enhanced monitoring.

6. Record-keeping and readiness for FIU/authority information calls
   - Retain reconstructable records and investigation workpapers (PMLA-2002-S12A-P02). Prepare documentation of linkage, timestamps, evidence IDs, and competing benign hypotheses for the Principal Officer’s review (PMLR-2005-R7-P04).

7. Cross-border and wire-monitoring considerations
   - Use FATF-R16-P05 / FATF-R16-P04 guidance to aggregate domestic and cross-border legs and to inspect unusual routing or rapid pass-throughs; consider CBWTR thresholds and retain UTR/party IDs.

Suggested escalation checklist for HO-REG (short, actionable)
- Step 1 — Evidence aggregation: produce summed value of linked legs across the rolling monthly window and list the involved accounts (per FIU-IND-RFI-BA-03; PMLR-2005-R7-P04).
- Step 2 — Hypotheses: document reasonable suspicion vs benign commercial explanations (invoices/GST/contract evidence) — required for Principal Officer review (PMLR-2005-R7-P04; PMLA-2002-S3-P06).
- Step 3 — Timing: if Principal Officer, upon review, concludes reasonable grounds exist, submit STR within 7 working days (PMLR-2005-R8-P01). If amounts meet CTR/CBWTR thresholds, ensure monthly filing by the 15th (PMLR-2005-R8-P01).
- Step 4 — Confidentiality & controls: do not tip off customer or impose account restrictions solely because STR filing is being considered; apply enhanced monitoring and preserve confidentiality (PMLA-2002-S12-P04; RBI-KYC-2016-P70-P02).
- Step 5 — Records readiness: store all raw transaction logs, exact decimal sums, investigation notes and evidentiary attachments for possible FIU or Section 12A information calls (PMLA-2002-S12A-P02).

Notes on analyst scope and limits
- Do not state or imply criminal guilt in internal reports — present neutral findings and evidence summaries for Principal Officer action (PMLA-2002-S3-P06).
- Use exact clause citations and evidence IDs when preparing the STR draft so Principal Officer can approve timely (PMLR-2005-R7-P04).

Hand-off HO-REG — summary of regulatory context, required clauses (IDs only) and investigator actions.

A. Applicable regulatory passages (IDs returned by search)
- FIU-IND red-flag guidance on structuring / smurfing: FIU-IND-RFI-BA-03
- PML Rules on aggregation/structuring and integrally connected cash: PMLR-2005-R3-P05
- PML Rules on STR obligations and recordkeeping (cash and non-cash; zero monetary floor for suspicion): PMLR-2005-R3-P03
- PML Rules on non-cash layering / electronic pass-through (scatter/gather): PMLR-2005-R3-P06
- PML Rules on statutory filing timetable (monthly threshold reports and STR deadline): PMLR-2005-R8-P01 and PMLR-2005-R8-P03
- PMLA statutory reporting posture and not-requiring-proof-of-predicate: PMLA-2002-S3-P06
- PMLA on enhanced due diligence / heightened monitoring after alerts: PMLA-2002-S12AA-P05

(These are the only clause IDs I relied on for legal thresholds, definitions and timeframes.)

B. Key regulatory thresholds and timeframes (as derived from the cited clauses)
- CTR/threshold reporting mechanics:
  - Rule 3(1)(A)/(B) — PMLR-2005-R3-P05 identifies the INR 10,00,000 cash-transaction aggregation threshold and requires aggregation of integrally connected cash legs across rolling monthly windows.
  - Rule 8(1) — PMLR-2005-R8-P01 sets monthly submission deadlines for threshold-based reports (CTR, CBWTR and related periodic filings) — by the 15th day of the succeeding month.
- Cross-Border Wire Transfer / CBWTR reference and monthly filing timing: see PMLR-2005-R8-P01.
- Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) obligations:
  - Rule 3(1)(D) — PMLR-2005-R3-P03 requires STR assessment and record maintenance for suspicious transactions whether cash or non-cash, with no minimum amount.
  - FIU-IND guidance FIU-IND-RFI-BA-03 identifies structuring/smurfing red flags (systematic splitting below the INR 10,00,000 CTR threshold) and directs aggregation across rolling monthly windows.
  - Rule 8 and its sub-rules — PMLR-2005-R8-P01 and PMLR-2005-R8-P03 require that once the Principal Officer is satisfied there are reasonable grounds for suspicion, an STR must be furnished promptly and not later than seven working days after that satisfaction.
- Non-cash layering / electronic scatter-gather:
  - PMLR-2005-R3-P06 explicitly covers rapid fan-out / fan-in electronic layering (IMPS/NEFT/RTGS) and requires reconstruction/analysis of multi-hop paths and preservation/STR assessment.

C. How the cited rules apply to the case facts (investigator checklist)
(Do not assume predicate crime or guilt — present neutral, evidence-backed findings. The investigator must follow the steps below before finalizing any STR.)

1) Aggregation and threshold analysis
- Using the account and path evidence (ACC-D0007-RT00 and linked accounts), aggregate all integrally connected cash legs and linked electronic legs across the relevant rolling monthly window per PMLR-2005-R3-P05 and FIU-IND-RFI-BA-03.
- Compare aggregated totals to the CTR threshold procedures (PMLR-2005-R3-P05) and CBWTR filing rules (PMLR-2005-R8-P01).

2) STR decision criteria
- Apply Rule 3(1)(D) (PMLR-2005-R3-P03) — if the pattern shows unusual complexity, deliberate structuring, rapid scatter/gather layering, unexplained pass-through velocity, or mismatch with declared business activity, these are reasonable grounds to escalate to STR regardless of single-leg amounts.
- Use FIU-IND-RFI-BA-03 for structuring red flags (coordinated sub-threshold deposits, timing proximity across related accounts).
- Non-cash multi-hop layering is explicitly reportable for suspicion per PMLR-2005-R3-P06.

3) Timing for reporting
- If an STR is warranted, file promptly and in any event within seven working days of the Principal Officer being satisfied (PMLR-2005-R8-P01 / PMLR-2005-R8-P03).
- Separate periodic threshold-based reports (CTR / CBWTR etc.) must still be filed by the 15th of the succeeding month when applicable (PMLR-2005-R8-P01).

4) Documentation and evidence to assemble for STR / compliance file
Per the cited clauses and EDD expectations (PMLA-2002-S12AA-P05; PMLR-2005-R3-P03 / PMLR-2005-R3-P06), collect and retain:
- Exact transaction ledger: timestamps, amounts (preserve exact decimals), rails (IMPS/NEFT/RTGS), transaction IDs, and directionality across the path nodes you listed (ACC-D0007-RT00 →

function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

parameters.description: Terminal tool submitting the structured `DispositionWorksheet` draft for deterministic verification.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

parameters.description: Terminal tool submitting the structured `DispositionWorksheet` draft for deterministic verification.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

regulatory_citations.description: Verified regulatory clause IDs retrieved from `compliance-kb`.

tool_calls.name: finish

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

parameters.description: Terminal tool submitting the structured `DispositionWorksheet` draft for deterministic verification.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

regulatory_citations.description: Verified regulatory clause IDs retrieved from `compliance-kb`.

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

parameters.description: Terminal tool submitting the structured `DispositionWorksheet` draft for deterministic verification.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

regulatory_citations.description: Verified regulatory clause IDs retrieved from `compliance-kb`.

tool_calls.name: finish

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

parameters.description: Terminal tool submitting the structured `DispositionWorksheet` draft for deterministic verification.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

regulatory_citations.description: Verified regulatory clause IDs retrieved from `compliance-kb`.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

parameters.description: Terminal tool submitting the structured `DispositionWorksheet` draft for deterministic verification.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

regulatory_citations.description: Verified regulatory clause IDs retrieved from `compliance-kb`.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

parameters.description: Terminal tool submitting the structured `DispositionWorksheet` draft for deterministic verification.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

regulatory_citations.description: Verified regulatory clause IDs retrieved from `compliance-kb`.

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

parameters.description: Terminal tool submitting the structured `DispositionWorksheet` draft for deterministic verification.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

regulatory_citations.description: Verified regulatory clause IDs retrieved from `compliance-kb`.
